limits: Stored time/id ordering and original time bytes are retained; this does not rewrite legacy timestamp representations
Explicit page-number jumps, older GUI back positions and the legacy offset API still pay offset costs
Sparse scopes can scan more candidates; the seek API bounds returned decoding, not all visited database rows
Concurrent arrivals are live evidence, not a fixed-time snapshot; newer arrivals require a head refresh
Long concurrent load, archival, full Folia and actual third-party stack acceptance remain open
